usage: The word '電' (din6) is used as a noun to refer to electricity or electric power.
It can be used in compound words to describe things related to electricity, such as 電話 (telephone) or 電視 (television).
In sentences, 電 usually functions as the subject or object when talking about electric energy or devices.
It can also be used metaphorically, for example, when describing something as electric or exciting in informal speech.
